course_id: Lịch sử Đảng Cộng Sản Việt Nam
title: History of the Communist Party of Vietnam

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to analyze historical events and their impact on political ideologies.
Ability to conduct research on historical events and periods.
Ability to think critically about historical events and their implications.
Ability to effectively communicate complex ideas and arguments.
Understanding of Marxist theory and its application to historical analysis.
Knowledge of Vietnamese political thought and its evolution over time.
Ability to document and interpret historical records accurately.
